purpose: Teach: カバー/臭い/クマ/思いっきり/水分/どっか/品物/大根

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、ふとんに、絶対、カバー、絶対、掛けてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Gran — your father was so particular about putting duvet covers on properly, remember? Truly he was.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia tinged with amusement. Soft attack. Measured pace, almost wondering. Voice settles gently as if sifting through old memories.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お野菜が、絶対、臭い、絶対、って、絶対、文句を言ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes. When you were younger, Grandpa — he really used to complain about the vegetables being smelly, didn't he, dear? You remember?
lines.style: Gentle, affectionate laughter underneath. Speaking with the ease of someone who has told this story before. Warm and direct, eyes crinkling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、クマ、絶対、目の下、絶対、夜なべ、絶対、続いたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Gran — you had such dark circles under your eyes from staying up late working, remember? Truly you did.
lines.style: Tender observation. Slight gravity — not sad, but acknowledging something that mattered. Voice softens on the remembering part, like a small apology for bringing it up.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、思いっきり、絶対、踊ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Grandpa — you danced with such abandon at the festivals, remember that, dear? You really did.
lines.style: Bright, delighted recall. Voice lifts slightly. The fondness is obvious — she's painting a picture of him alive and free. Quick, genuine warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、水分、絶対、を、絶対、忘れずに、絶対、勧めたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Gran — you were always reminding my father not to forget his water, remember? So careful you were.
lines.style: Soft appreciation in the voice. Steady, simple. Like noticing a kindness that was so small at the time it only mattered afterward. Quiet respect.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、どっか、絶対、お出かけしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Grandpa — the two of us went out somewhere together, didn't we, dear? Do you remember?
lines.style: Playful, slightly teasing. A question asked like she already knows the answer and is inviting him to play along. Light, warm, intimate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、品物、絶対、を、絶対、選んでくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Gran — you used to choose such nice things for my father, remember? You were so thoughtful.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, speaking as if discovering something true about her all over again. Calm, steady, a little reverent. No rush.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お庭で、絶対、大根、絶対、を、絶対、育てたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: When you were younger, Grandpa — you grew daikon in the garden, didn't you, dear? Such big ones too, if I remember right.
lines.style: Soft pride and contentment. Speaking like she can still see the garden. Warm, unhurried, with the ease of someone who was there and is letting him know she remembers him in it.
